about: What a viewpoint effectively holds: everything it can reach, all at
Reaching means holding. A viewpoint that reaches another carries both
sets of statements, so they combine — and the result can cross when
neither side crosses alone. Checking viewpoints one at a time cannot
`held` maps a name to the statement it carries directly; a name with
no entry carries nothing and contributes nothing. `bounds` is null
when the whole reach carries nothing at all.
The `escalates` case is the point of the file. Both `a` and `b` are
satisfiable alone and their combination is not.

coverage.criterion: alone, one hop, two hops, a cycle, and an escalation that only the composite shows
coverage.why: one scale and one graph shape per case; the index and a walk over the edges are compared on every case by this file's runner

walked: the reach the index computes is the reach a walk over the edges finds, for every case's graph
